title: Canonical coefficient-first compact-support projection map
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring of universe $u+1$, let $X,Y$ be schemes of universe $u$, and use the ordinary unbounded small-etale module derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and their derived tensor product [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Given a morphism $f:X\to Y$, a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow j\overline X\xrightarrow pY)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and objects $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, write $F_f^c=Rp_*Dj_!$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Let $\mathrm{PF}_c:F_f^cM\otimes^L K\to F_f^c(M\otimes^L Lf^*K)$ be the composite of the proper projection map [def-kun-projection-formula-map], the inverse open-extension tensor comparison [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor], and the canonical derived inverse-image composition identification. Write $\eta_{f,K}:Lf^*K\xrightarrow\sim D(f^*)K$ for the canonical comparison with exact termwise inverse image [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal], and $\sigma$ for the signed derived tensor symmetry [lem-kun-tensor-sym]. Define the coefficient-first compact-support projection to be the actual composite
$$P^c_{f;K,M}:K\otimes^L F_f^cM\xrightarrow{\sigma_{K,F_f^cM}}F_f^cM\otimes^L K\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PF}_c}F_f^c(M\otimes^L Lf^*K)\xrightarrow{F_f^c(1_M\otimes\eta_{f,K})}F_f^c(M\otimes^L D(f^*)K)\xrightarrow{F_f^c(\sigma_{D(f^*)K,M}^{-1})}F_f^c(D(f^*)K\otimes^L M).$$
When $f$ has a compactifiability structure, define $P_{f;K,M}$ by this formula for its selected compactification, with $F_f=Rf_!$ the corresponding chosen compact-support functor. This defines the maps on all unbounded objects, without assuming finiteness of $A$, Noetherianity of the schemes or invertibility of these maps; it asserts no composition or refinement compatibility theorem.

lean.statement:
noncomputable def compactSupportProjectionMap
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f]
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).obj K).obj
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj M) ⟶
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj
        (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)).obj M)
